pipeline.input: Pure wood frame point cloud. No drywall or sheathing. LiDAR device not named yet.
pipeline.first_class: Vertical studs only. Plates and beams are later.
stages: tight oriented bounding box per stud
device and software error band when supplied
pipeline.tolerance_note: Derived atan((1/4 inch)/(10 feet)) from the Handbook figure as summarized by WoodWorks. Not an IRC clause. NAHB 3/8 inch in 32 inches and UFGS 1/4 inch in 8 feet are different angles.

color_rule.theta: Angle between stud OBB long axis and floor normal. 0 deg means perpendicular to the floor.
color_rule.epsilon: Half-width of device-plus-software error on theta. Unknown until Oz supplies it.
color_rule.yellow: Interval overlaps the tolerance, or epsilon is unknown. Until epsilon exists, every stud is yellow.

pipeline.shared_post_step: Every algorithm stops at instances. The same OBB, floor angle, and epsilon wrap paints all of them.

intcdc_classical_trial.source: Draft PR 7 runbook and paint script narrative. Not on main. Not an accuracy.
intcdc_classical_trial.why_not_a_score: Heavy timber, file Z is not documented as gravity, DBSCAN merges contacts, warn band is not a device error.

top5_why: Head-to-head on the same clouds: corrected Open3D stud prior, PCL timber cuboids, Schnabel primitives as an independent check, Pointcept after labels (BIMStruct3D zero-shot as a control), and one S3DIS Open3D-ML pass so office mIoU is not reused.

ranking.name: Refined Open3D stud prior (horizontal plate peel, DBSCAN below the bay gap, vertical-stick filter, tight OBB)
ranking.stud_instance_quality: Expected to separate bare 2x4 studs after near-horizontal plates are removed and DBSCAN eps is below the clear bay gap. Unmeasured. The IntCDC trial of the unrefined recipe merged touching members (449 components; not a stud score).
ranking.tight_obb: Yes. PointCloud.get_oriented_bounding_box and get_minimal_oriented_bounding_box. A cluster that contains two members yields one bad box.
ranking.angle_then_paint: Bolt-on. Theta versus the stored floor normal, then the epsilon rule. Draft PR 7 paint_gravity_deviation.py uses a 0.24 deg warn factor and is not yellow.
ranking.device_error: Not native. We wrap epsilon. Unknown epsilon forces yellow on every stud.
ranking.reported_accuracy: No published stud accuracy. IntCDC trial counts are a log, not mIoU or angle RMSE. Do not cite S3DIS here.
ranking.fit_why: A bare stud wall is separated vertical sticks once plates are gone, and this stack already ends in a box and an angle.
ranking.next_experiment: On one local bare-frame cloud, peel only near-horizontal plates, cluster with eps below the bay gap, fit one OBB per stud, compute theta versus the floor normal, and paint every stud yellow until epsilon exists.

ranking.name: PCL RegionGrowing plus cuboid (Ozkan / Pochtrager rules; no Bassier remote coplanar merge)
ranking.pricing: OSS, no fee. OPALS, which Ozkan names for segmentation, was not priced this pass.
ranking.stud_instance_quality: Expected to beat DBSCAN when one stud is several faces or a joint bridges a cluster. Expected to fail if coplanar stud faces are merged across a bay. Unmeasured on 2x4. Open3D has no region-growing call; PCL RegionGrowing is the host.
ranking.tight_obb: Yes as a fitted cuboid in the timber papers. Map that cuboid into the same OBB schema as rank 1 for the bake-off.
ranking.angle_then_paint: Bolt-on with the shared floor-normal and epsilon wrap. The papers do not paint plumb. Do not force the member axis to global Z.
ranking.hardware: CPU. pcl::RegionGrowing is a CPU segmentation class.
ranking.public_wood_stud_checkpoint: None. No public stud weight. OPALS is not a checkpoint.
ranking.reported_accuracy: Ozkan et al. 2022, one historic roof, manual beam count: completeness 29% (Pochtrager method) to 63% (theirs), 75% with extra manual splits. Northern transept 199 beams, modeled 61/129/150. Southern 194, modeled 53/117/146. 1179 cuboids from 4758 linear side segments. Chen, Jiang, and Xiong 2025, one 114854-point timber specimen: dimension relative error within 3%; plane angles within 1 deg; cylinders assumed axis (0,0,1). Not stud scores.
ranking.fit_why: This is the published way to turn exposed timber faces into member cuboids, and it must not copy wall-style coplanar merges or a forced vertical axis.
ranking.next_experiment: Port PCL region growing, split non-linear segments, fit cuboids without remote coplanar joins, and compare merged-bay and split-stud counts to rank 1 on the same cloud.

ranking.name: CloudCompare RANSAC Shape Detection via CloudComPy
ranking.license: GPL-3.0. CloudCompare README forbids closed-source linking. CloudComPy CMake header is GPL-3.0.
ranking.stud_instance_quality: Weak on a stud wall. The detector returns planes, spheres, cylinders, cones, and tori. Coplanar stud faces collapse to one plane. A cylinder is the wrong section for a 2x4.
ranking.tight_obb: No stud OBB in the plugin. Fit our box on each primitive's inliers if a primitive happens to be one stud.
ranking.angle_then_paint: Bolt-on after that box, same floor normal and epsilon rule.
ranking.hardware: CPU desktop. CloudComPy embeds the RANSAC_SD plugin.
ranking.reported_accuracy: Schnabel, Wahl, and Klein 2007 detect those five primitives on CAD-like shapes. No residential stud accuracy is stated. CloudCompare does not add a stud score.
ranking.fit_why: It is an independent classical fitter for the bake-off, and its primitives are a poor model of a rectangular stud.
ranking.next_experiment: Run RANSAC-SD on the same bare-frame cloud and compare primitive count and coverage to rank 1's stud count.

ranking.name: Pointcept PTv3 / PointGroup fine-tune; BIMStruct3D weights as a zero-shot control only
ranking.license: Pointcept code MIT. BIMStruct3D weights CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. BIMStruct3D segment_scan.py code MIT.
ranking.pricing: OSS code, no fee. The NC weight file is not a commercial license.
ranking.stud_instance_quality: Zero-shot expected poor: the public construction head has wall and column, not stud. Fine-tune quality is unknown until stud labels exist. Finished-interior ScanNet weights are the wrong domain.
ranking.tight_obb: No box head. Cluster points of a stud class, then the rank 1 OBB.
ranking.angle_then_paint: Bolt-on after the box. The network does not know 0.12 deg or epsilon.
ranking.hardware: CUDA. BIMStruct3D card example: about 8 minutes for 6.6 million points on an RTX 4090 with 10x test-time augmentation.
ranking.labels_needed: Yes for a stud model. Zero-shot control needs no new labels and is not a stud model.
ranking.public_wood_stud_checkpoint: None. BIMStruct3D classes: clutter, floor, ceiling, wall, column, door, window, stairs, railing, lights. No stud, plate, beam, or timber.
ranking.reported_accuracy: No wood-stud metric. S3DIS and ScanNet scores are intentionally not copied. DeKH mIoU was not re-fetched this pass. ERES 2026 timber abstract names PointNet++, GrowSP, RandLA-Net, and SQN on 20 timber structures and publishes no mIoU and no code URL.
ranking.fit_why: After stud labels this is the instance model to train; the public weights we could run tomorrow are indoor construction classes, not 2x4s.
ranking.next_experiment: Run BIMStruct3D zero-shot on one bare frame and record the label histogram, then fine-tune Pointcept only after stud instance labels exist on that same cloud.

ranking.name: Open3D-ML RandLA-Net or KPConv with S3DIS weights
ranking.license: Open3D-ML MIT. Upstream QingyongHu/RandLA-Net is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Confirm the in-tree file header before shipping.
ranking.pricing: OSS, no fee for the MIT tree. Non-commercial if the upstream RandLA-Net repo is used instead.
ranking.stud_instance_quality: Poor. Semantic segmentation of office rooms (beam, column, wall, furniture) or of driving scenes if outdoor weights are loaded. Not stud instances.
ranking.tight_obb: No. Any box would be fit by us on a class that is not stud.
ranking.angle_then_paint: Do not paint green or red from these labels. A bolt-on box would still be required and would not be trustworthy.
ranking.device_error: Not native. We wrap epsilon only if a later fine-tune produces real stud instances.
ranking.hardware: GPU typical for the zoo models. A CPU-only runtime was not established this pass.
ranking.labels_needed: Pretrained weights need no new labels and are the wrong classes. A stud fine-tune would need labels we do not have.
ranking.public_wood_stud_checkpoint: None. Nearest vocabulary is S3DIS beam and column, which are office structure.
ranking.reported_accuracy: Open3D-ML model_zoo.md as recorded in docs/research/08 on the unmerged PR 4 branch (surveyed 2026-09-23, not re-fetched 2026-09-24): RandLA-Net S3DIS mIoU 70.9; KPConv S3DIS TensorFlow 65.0 and PyTorch 60.0. Benchmark is S3DIS, not studs.
ranking.fit_why: One forward pass retires the idea that an S3DIS beam class is a wood stud; it is not a segmenter we should ship.
ranking.next_experiment: Run one S3DIS RandLA-Net or KPConv checkpoint on the same bare-frame cloud and save the label histogram. Do not convert those labels into green or red.

ranking.name: Lin Chen, Liufang Jiang, and Haibei Xiong 2025 region-grow finite-element reconstruction
ranking.license: Paper is CC BY 4.0. No public code found this pass.
ranking.pricing: n/a. Method only. No software SKU.
ranking.stud_instance_quality: Unknown on 2x4. The case study is one small timber structure, 114854 points, not a residential stud wall.
ranking.tight_obb: Hexahedra from plane intersections. Cylinders are forced to global Z, so lean is not an output.
ranking.angle_then_paint: Cannot, as published. Vertical members are assumed plumb. Their plane-angle check is against the global axis, within 1 deg, which is coarser than 0.12 deg.
ranking.device_error: Not provided. The Leica P40 spec they quote (8 arcsec angular, 1.2 mm plus or minus 10 ppm) is an instrument brochure figure, not epsilon on stud theta.
ranking.hardware: CPU in their case: laptop Intel i7-11800H, about 9.75 seconds.
ranking.reported_accuracy: Their specimen only: dimension relative error within 3 percent; absolute angular error of planes versus horizontal or vertical within 1 deg. Not a stud-plumb RMSE and not mIoU.
ranking.fit_why: The grow recipe overlaps rank 2, and the published cylinder step deletes the lean we need to paint.
ranking.next_experiment: Do not reimplement as a sixth stack. Keep the lesson inside rank 2: never force the stud axis to Z.

ranking.name: ClearEdge3D EdgeWise
ranking.pricing: EdgeWise Lite USD 1995 per year on the product page fetched 2026-09-24. EdgeWise Pro list price unknown (not printed on that page).
ranking.stud_instance_quality: Not expected. Documented targets are piping, structure, ducts, walls, conduit, cable trays, and structural steel. Wood studs are not named. Automated wall extraction is a wall, not a stud schedule.
ranking.tight_obb: Vendor fits spec-matched BIM geometry. Not our stud OBB.
ranking.angle_then_paint: No floor-angle paint found. SmartSheet reports coverage, specification, length, and RMSE.
ranking.device_error: SmartSheet RMSE is fit-to-cloud, not epsilon on theta.
ranking.labels_needed: No labels from us. Extraction models are the vendor's.
ranking.reported_accuracy: No stud metric. The page's 'up to 73%' figure is a vendor speed claim, not an accuracy.
ranking.fit_why: It extracts walls and steel, which is the wrong unit for bare 2x4 studs.
ranking.next_experiment: Leave out of the bake-off unless a vendor page names light-frame stud instances.

ranking.name: PointCab Origins + 4Revit
ranking.pricing: unknown. Doc 02 shop URLs (Origins Core EUR 3000 and Origins 3D EUR 4900 excl. VAT, fetched 2026-09-23) returned HTTP 404 on 2026-09-24. Do not treat those figures as a live cart.
ranking.stud_instance_quality: Not an automatic stud segmenter. 4Revit builds a column or wall from points the user picks.
ranking.tight_obb: User-guided column, not an automatic tight stud box.
ranking.angle_then_paint: No floor-angle or gravity command found in doc 02. We would export geometry and wrap the paint ourselves.
ranking.fit_why: It is a click-to-model path, not an algorithm we can run unattended on the same clouds.
ranking.next_experiment: Skip until the vendor documents automatic wood-stud instances.

ranking.name: Leica CloudWorx for Revit
ranking.pricing: unknown. No official list price was opened this pass. Reseller snippets were not used.
ranking.stud_instance_quality: Not expected. Doc 02 records fitters for steel, flanges, pipes, walls, floors, doors, and windows, not light-frame studs.
ranking.tight_obb: BIM solids from those fitters, not a raw-cloud stud OBB.
ranking.angle_then_paint: No gravity or floor-angle number found (doc 02).
ranking.hardware: Revit plugin. CPU versus GPU unknown.
ranking.fit_why: The documented objects are steel and pipe, not a bare wood stud.

ranking.name: Forestry stem segmenters (cylinder stems under canopy)
ranking.license: Varies by tool. Not surveyed tool-by-tool this pass.
ranking.stud_instance_quality: Wrong object. A stem in a forest is not a 2x4 in a bay. Demoted on purpose.
ranking.tight_obb: Typically a cylinder along the stem. Wrong section for a stud.
ranking.hardware: Often CPU. Not confirmed per tool this pass.
ranking.labels_needed: Some tools need plot data or allometry. They do not need stud labels, and that does not make them relevant.
ranking.reported_accuracy: Forest detection rates and RMSE were not copied. They are not stud metrics.
ranking.fit_why: The object class is a tree stem, so a strong forestry score would still be the wrong experiment.

ranking.name: Finished-interior zero-shot instance nets (ScanNet or S3DIS models beyond ranks 4 and 5)
ranking.license: Read each repo. Pointcept code is MIT. Some weight files are non-commercial.
ranking.pricing: OSS code, no fee, unless the weight license says otherwise.
ranking.stud_instance_quality: Wrong scene. Finished rooms, furniture, and office structure. A bare stud wall is a domain shift.
ranking.angle_then_paint: A bolt-on paint would color boxes that are not studs.
ranking.labels_needed: Benchmark weights exist. They are not stud labels.
ranking.reported_accuracy: ScanNet instance AP and S3DIS mIoU stay on those benchmarks. Not recopied, because copying them would look like stud accuracy.
ranking.fit_why: Another indoor checkpoint would repeat the rank 5 failure without adding a stud class.
ranking.next_experiment: Do not run a second finished-interior net beyond the rank 5 control.

ranking.name: ClearEdge3D Verity
ranking.pricing: unknown. The product page describes a quote path. No list price was copied.
ranking.stud_instance_quality: Not a segmenter. Requires a design or fabrication model plus the as-built cloud.
ranking.tight_obb: Compares elements that are already modeled. It does not invent stud boxes from a raw frame.
ranking.angle_then_paint: Reports deviation from the model element, including rotation, not from the floor, unless the model itself is square to the floor. Tolerances are user-set.
ranking.device_error: A user tolerance is not a sensor epsilon.
ranking.labels_needed: Needs a model, not point labels.
ranking.reported_accuracy: No stud-segmentation score. Doc 02 records a DPR case that used a 1 inch tolerance on steel beams. That is a project setting, not wood-stud QA.
ranking.fit_why: Verity can check a stud model after one exists; it cannot find studs in a raw frame cloud.
ranking.next_experiment: Hold for a later scan-versus-model stage. Do not put it in the segmentation bake-off.

bakeoff_adds.name: pyRANSAC-3D v0.7.0 sequential cuboid after the rank-1 peel
bakeoff_adds.master_table_rank_6_remains: Lin Chen, Liufang Jiang, and Haibei Xiong 2025

bakeoff_adds.name: SAM 2 image/video mask, lifted onto points
bakeoff_adds.license: Apache-2.0 (code and official checkpoints). Not linked in this pass.
bakeoff_adds.how_it_applies: Project a registered RGB or depth view, take a mask, lift visible points, then the shared box. A bare LAS or PLY skips it. Multi-view lifts would be unioned.
bakeoff_adds.note: Oz_PC ran facebook/sam2.1-hiera-tiny through transformers on an RTX 4080 SUPER. The predicted mask IoU is the network score, not a stud mIoU. Kept-stud cells stay null: the visible span is 1.010 m and the keep gate starts at 1.2 m. The cloud CPU card remains blocked_install. The generator-mask control is not a SAM 2 score.
